answer: Locks are written down in copper, expire in karst, and zenith lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 94 aliases thus needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3446 identities would post 4635 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
